stories.title: Russian drones strike Kyiv data center twice, children among the injured
stories.summary: Russian drones struck a data center in Kyiv twice on the morning of Sept. 27, injuring three people including two children, per President Zelensky and Mayor Klitschko. It is part of an expanded long-range campaign that has seen more than 2,200 attack drones used this month, keeping Ukrainian cities under sustained pressure.

stories.title: Russia and Ukraine exchange 157 prisoners each as Abu Dhabi talks end without breakthrough
stories.summary: Russia and Ukraine swapped 157 prisoners on each side - the first such exchange in four months, including seven Ukrainian civilians - after two days of U.S.-brokered peace talks in Abu Dhabi ended without a deal. The swap shows prisoner diplomacy continues even as a broader settlement remains out of reach.

stories.title: Putin unlikely to agree to energy ceasefire before winter, ISW assesses
stories.summary: The Institute for the Study of War assesses that Putin is unlikely to accept an energy ceasefire before winter, betting instead on long-range strikes against Ukraine's power grid. The assessment tempers U.S. hopes that a proposed halt to attacks on energy infrastructure could take hold this season.

stories.title: Dark web sells cut-price access to Claude, Gemini and ChatGPT, prices double
stories.summary: The Financial Times reports dark-web marketplaces are selling unauthorized access to frontier AI models - Anthropic's Claude, Google's Gemini and OpenAI's ChatGPT - at discounts of up to 97%, with stolen account prices more than doubling in 2026. The trend reflects surging demand for cheap agentic AI and deepens security concerns around account theft.

stories.title: Google tests direct Flipkart purchases inside Gemini and AI Mode in India
stories.summary: Google is testing a 'Buy' button that lets Indian shoppers purchase Walmart-owned Flipkart products directly inside Gemini and AI Mode, moving AI assistants into commerce. It builds on Google's Universal Commerce Protocol push to make agentic AI able to transact with retailers.

stories.title: Deshaun Watson in spotlight as Browns face Panthers in home opener
stories.summary: Deshaun Watson carries the focus Sunday as the Browns (1-1) open their home schedule against the Carolina Panthers at Huntington Bank Field, with turnovers and consistency the key concerns. It marks Watson's first regular-season home start in nearly two years.

stories.title: Julian Sayin answers Ryan Day's challenge in Ohio State's win over Illinois
stories.summary: Julian Sayin threw for 367 yards and four touchdowns plus a rushing score, a career-high five total TDs, as No. 7 Ohio State beat Illinois 42-19 in its Big Ten opener. Sayin completed 27 of 36 passes without an interception, delivering the playmaking Day had called for.

stories.title: Ohio State defense shows cracks despite clutch stops in win over Illinois
stories.summary: Ohio State's defense surrendered 462 yards, the most under coordinator Matt Patricia, even as clutch fourth-quarter stops secured the 42-19 win over Illinois. After losing eight starters to the NFL draft, the young unit faces another test next week at No. 17 Iowa.

stories.title: Jeremiah Smith ties Ohio State record with 4 TD catches in 42-19 win
stories.summary: Jeremiah Smith tied Ohio State's single-game record with four touchdown receptions, finishing with 12 catches for 217 yards in the No. 7 Buckeyes' Big Ten-opening win over Illinois. He surpassed 3,000 career receiving yards, joining the Big Ten's all-time top 10.

stories.title: Franco Colapinto gets 5-place grid penalty for Bahrain GP after Baku crash
stories.summary: Franco Colapinto was handed a five-place grid penalty for next weekend's Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia after triggering the multi-car Azerbaijan GP crash that eliminated his Alpine teammate Pierre Gasly and McLaren's Lando Norris. He also carried a 10-second time penalty during the Baku race.

stories.title: Columbus man who pleaded guilty in deadly road-rage shooting retains new counsel
stories.summary: The Columbus man convicted over the deadly I-670 road-rage shooting has retained new counsel and intends to reverse his plea, after he had previously pleaded guilty in the case. He has maintained the shooting was self-defense.

stories.title: Three men sentenced after fight that led to Columbus man's death
stories.summary: Three men were sentenced in connection with a fight that led to a Columbus man's death, closing a case stemming from the altercation. Authorities did not detail the exact terms of the sentences in the announcement.

stories.title: Mac and Cheese Festival returning to Easton on Friday to raise money for cancer research
stories.summary: The Mac and Cheese Festival returns to Easton Town Center on Friday, pairing chef-driven mac-and-cheese dishes with fundraising for cancer research. It is one of several annual Columbus food events tied to charity causes.
